source.release_commit_mapping: Computational files and pyproject are byte-verified against this tested manifest before publication; the containing Git commit and a separate private release receipt record the published commit. Actual run provenance remains the uncommitted frozen snapshot.

scope.baseline: original upstream CPU tools in controlled Conda wrapper; same input, reference, known sites, RG, CPU and scientific options
scope.candidate: same BWA/GKL; bounded parallel original BQSR engines; canonical replay; shared QC and normal-return pool exit

experiment.failed_historical_candidate_reason: strict PSS observer rejected transient inconsistent smaps; scientific BQSR had not started

cold_BQSR_build.timing_scope: measured build stage commands and artifact checks; included in total public API wall; other API setup is separate

cold_QC_build.timing_scope: measured build stage commands and artifact checks; included in total public API wall; other API setup is separate

limits: One paired pipeline comparison with the successful original baseline reused after an observation-only guard fix, not a statistical speed distribution.
A real sparse 10M paired prefix with 8.8Mb calling, not full-depth full-subject or long-duration multi-subject validation.
PSS/RSS peaks and tail trends are sampled observations; process exit and close receipts have separate coverage.
rchar/wchar are logical bytes; local read_bytes/write_bytes do not quantify CPFS network or server storage IO.
